data.why: This is a real DICOM RT Plan fixture shipped in the repo's own test suite; the MetersetMap app's 'File Upload/Download Only' config accepts DICOM RT Plan uploads directly for both the reference and evaluation deliveries without any network access, letting the gamma comparison run end to end.

goals: Upload a planned (reference) DICOM RT Plan and a delivered/re-exported (evaluation) DICOM RT Plan and compute the MLC fluence (MetersetMap) for each
Run a local gamma analysis (dose-percent and distance-mm thresholds) between the reference and evaluation MetersetMaps and read off the percent pass rate
Inspect the reference, evaluation, difference, and gamma-index images and the gamma histogram to see where the two deliveries disagree
Adjust gamma parameters (percent/distance thresholds, local vs global gamma, max gamma) in Advanced Mode and see how the pass rate changes
Save the comparison as a PNG/PDF QA report for the record

review.summary: The tree accurately records how to set up a planned-vs-delivered MetersetMap comparison: inputs, gamma criteria and output paths, with screenshots that match. But the calculation never finished, so the actual purpose of the tool (pass rate, the four maps and histogram, comparing criteria, the saved QA report) is absent from both the tree and the features. Keep the setup half, tighten its button-level tasks, and rerun to capture the result and report stages before filing.
